change.behavior: Deleting a node or subtree removes Page Actions in surviving nodes that target any deleted node. Undo restores the target and action from the same snapshot; Redo repeats valid cleanup. A detached action-only button remains unpublishable until the owner supplies a valid link, preserving the existing publication guidance. Save stays draft-only and Publish remains explicit.
